It is not a generated image and not an instruction to enlarge the note or imitate enlarged pixels. Image2 remains the authority for composition, card scale, backing and source alpha. Compare only the irregular group shapes, relative lengths and compact footprint; do not invent readable text or replace the person.

MASK CONTRACT: A separate same-size RGBA PNG mask accompanies this request; it is not Image5 and not another ordered reference image. Mask alpha<255 pixels are the only permitted regeneration regions, and alpha=255 pixels must be preserved. Its one transparent rectangle covers only the two incorrect note-mark rows with a narrow paper margin. Do not regenerate the gray-haired person with glasses, moustache and beard, suit, white shirt collar and dark tie, photographic frame/backplate, correct right-edge tab or blank lower paper. Within that region use Image2 and Image4 to restore exactly TWO separated source-scale irregular gray-mark groups in EACH row, with original relative lengths and spacing, not repeated dots, uniform short dashes, long bars or newly readable writing. Retain original paper colour, texture and lighting. The mask does not redefine the original card exterior alpha or authorize removing backing; preserve genuine native exterior transparency and opaque person, photographic backing and note interior.

ACTUAL OBSERVED CORRECTION: The source has TWO separated irregular gray-mark groups in EACH of its two note rows. External-04 still substitutes four repeated round/short-dash marks in the upper row and three in the lower row, with changed relative lengths and grouping. Restore exactly TWO source-scale irregular groups in EACH row with their original separation and compact footprint, not generic dots or short bars. Keep the lower paper blank and preserve the repaired continuous right edge and small tab.

The exact original note has TWO separated irregular gray-mark groups in its upper note row and TWO separated irregular gray-mark groups in its lower row. Restore exactly TWO source-scale irregular groups in EACH row, with the original relative lengths, spacing and compact footprint. They are not generic repeated dots, uniform short dashes, long horizontal bars, extra groups or newly readable writing. Keep the lower paper blank outside the original marks and retain the original small dark right-edge tab.

Preserve every already-correct part of Image1: the yellow compact mascot identity, green-ringed black eyes, exactly one source-appropriate mouth, source-visible hair, brows and facial hair, headgear, clothing, decorations, expression, head pose, crop and lighting. Do not replace the person with a human or a generic mascot. Preserve the short broad fitted neck and correct collar without pinching, floating cloth or a cream bib.

SOURCE-VISIBLE CONTRACT FROM IMAGE2:
No headgear. Preserve wavy medium-brown hair swept upward/back with a high forehead and lighter gray-brown sides, dark brows and round thin-framed glasses. Keep the thick dark-brown moustache and dense short chin/jaw beard; the cheeks are largely clear and the beard must not be lengthened or removed. Preserve the dark navy/black jacket, white pointed shirt collar and dark tie mostly in beard shadow; no medals are visible.
Static bust portrait with the head turned slightly viewer left, gaze left and a stern expression whose mouth is partly obscured by the moustache. Preserve the original tight head-and-upper-chest crop and right-side note occlusion. Keep the directional upper-left light, bright forehead and darker opposite cheek/beard areas.
The dark gray-green rectangle is a real opaque photographic backplate with subdued mottling and a thin dark frame; lock its color, brightness and texture. Preserve the real cream note at right with its existing faint mark groups, blank areas, edges and shadow. Only the exterior around the whole card/note silhouette is transparent: produce genuine native transparency directly; do not use a working matte or defer alpha restoration; invent no interior backdrop, halo or smoke. Keep body, clothing, frame and note opaque.
Return genuine native transparency only outside the complete original card/frame/note silhouette. Preserve the opaque photographic backing and every subject, garment, frame and note interior; no working matte, halo, smoke, interior holes or invented scene. Do not invent readable text, extra note rows, people, symbols or comparison panels. Keep the full returned detail and original composition; no watermark.
The exact sideburn/beard boundary on the cheeks, fine glasses-rim detail and note glyphs are not fully resolvable at 65x67.
